Home / Company

Major-project standards, local roots

Founded in 2023 in Petit-Bourg and led by Johane Devouton, TMI draws on more than 15 years of combined public works experience.

Who we are

Five trades, one standard

TMI works in water networks, roadworks, utilities and earthworks, asphalt, special works (special foundations, retaining structures, slope stabilisation and seismic reinforcement), building and civil engineering.

Since its creation, the company has built up its technical and human resources to improve performance and quality. Its technical, administrative and financial capabilities allow it to take on public contracts and private projects alike.

Safety, cleanliness, quality, environmental management and meeting deadlines are our priorities on every site.

  4. 202610 M€

A word from our President

Dear colleagues and partners,

In creating Travaux Modernes Ingénierie, we set out to build far more than a construction company: to bring together women and men who share strong values of respect, high standards, quality, listening and responsibility.

We are a close-knit team, rooted in Guadeloupe, Martinique and Saint-Martin, driven by one ambition: to build to last, in a way that values our islands, the environment and the projects of the people who live here.

Since 2023, we have moved forward with seriousness and passion to deliver projects that are solid, useful and meaningful. Our technical skills are in place, and so are our people and equipment. What makes the difference is our collective commitment.

TMI is young and already ready for major challenges. The best is yet to come, and we look forward to building it with you.

Johane Devouton
